domain: Children's Clothing Size Specification and Measurement Standards
scenario:
A global children's clothing retailer is developing an enterprise-level inventory management and product information system to manage its extensive range of clothing products. The system will facilitate the design, production, and distribution of children's clothing by maintaining detailed specifications for each product. This includes size measurements, product categories, materials, and manufacturing details.

The platform needs to handle various clothing product lines, each with multiple size categories tailored to specific age groups. It will store detailed measurement specifications for each size to ensure consistent production standards. The system must also track inventory levels across different warehouses and retail locations globally, manage supplier information, and monitor sales performance.

A comprehensive reporting and analytics feature is required to analyze sales trends, predict demand, and optimize inventory across different regions. The system should also support customer feedback integration to refine product offerings and improve customer satisfaction. Advanced user roles and permissions will enable secure access control for different departments, such as design, production, sales, and logistics.
